title: Kaelon' s Survival
description: Survive, fight, go on an adventure.
body:
**Kaelon’s Survival**
> Dungeons are bigger, creatures are smarter, and the sky is finally yours! A completely overhauled world with 140+ mods.
>  * **Exploration:** Massive caves and revamped structures.
>  * **Combat:** New magic systems and animated weaponry.
>  * **Survival:** Challenging mechanics and unique equipment.
> The adventure begins now.
>
